title: A Descriptive and Normative Theory of Human Beliefs in RLHF
reasoning: The paper presents a theory and empirical study concerning human beliefs and biases in the RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) alignment process. While it mentions 'normative' ideals and alignment safety, it frames these within the context of decision-theoretic optimization (maximizing expected return) rather than as a benchmark or evaluation of moral, ethical, or religious values.
